channel.title: Pier — Blog
channel.description: Practical writing on legacy websites, FTP, MySQL and AI-assisted edits.

item.title: Reading slow_query_log on shared hosting: four patterns
item.description: Four MySQL slow_query_log patterns that explain most of the pain on shared hosting. The EXPLAIN you will see, the index that fixes it, and the ones you can leave alone.
item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: Magento 1.9 to Magento 2: a six-weekend live cutover

item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: Slow admin-ajax.php: tracing 30 seconds back to one plugin
item.description: A WooCommerce backend hung for 30 seconds on every page load. The slow request was always admin-ajax.php. Here is how we traced it to one Heartbeat plugin.
item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: wp-config.php debug constants: a working cheatsheet
item.description: Forty documented wp-config.php constants ship with WordPress. Most sites use three of them. Here are the rest, written as a working cheatsheet you can paste in tonight.
item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: Joomla 2.5 component to Joomla 5 plugin: skip the rewrite
item.description: An old Joomla 2.5 component still runs the client's catalogue. PHP 8.2 is coming. Here's how to lift it onto Joomla 5 as a plugin without touching the schema.

item.title: Quoting legacy work: a four-tier scope letter that holds
item.description: The four-tier scope letter we send before touching anyone's legacy site. Quote the surface, ringfence the swamp, and keep the client honest about what they're actually asking for.
item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: Finding the rogue cron filling /tmp: a 12 GB session leak

item.dc:creator: Pier editorial

item.title: Magento CSV import without downtime: a 9,000-row swap
item.description: A 23:41 Loom, a 9,043-row supplier CSV, and a storefront that could not go down. The post-mortem on how a Dutch agency staged the import without losing a minute of uptime.

item.title: The two-monitor habit: keeping FTP and MySQL in one glance

item.title: 14 PHP includes per page: a dependency-mapping playbook
